name: account-plan
title: Account growth plan
for_each: select id,name from accounts where status='active' order by code

sections.title: Account objective
sections.sql: select name,owner,objective,review_due from accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Growth plays
sections.sql: select name,owner,success_measure,due,status from plays where account_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Coverage
sections.note: Internal planning estimates; check before sharing.
sections.sql: select business_unit,product,status,potential_cents,currency,attention from whitespace where account_id=$1 order by code

name: review-agenda
title: Quarterly account review agenda
for_each: select id,name from accounts where status='active' order by code

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select name,owner,objective,review_due from accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Actions to discuss
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,attention from action_queue where account_id=$1 and status='open' order by due

sections.title: Recent reviews
sections.sql: select note,next_due,actor,created_at from reviews where account_id=$1 order by created_at desc
